name: pumped oscillator (parametron principle)

slots.Xi: tank voltage and its rate of change: R^2
slots.C: the pump modulates the stiffness of the tank (its inductance or capacitance)
slots.R: phase of the tank oscillation relative to the pump
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of k
slots.A: mu=0.5, k=1; control k in (0.5, 1.5); noise D=0.01

provenance: principle: von Neumann, US patent 2,815,488 (1957); Goto, Proc. IRE 47, 1304 (1959); here with a self-sustained van der Pol tank
loss_law: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)

verdict.stores: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)
verdict.constructs: a single stable state: no write point
verdict.holds: no stable state: a limit cycle, whose phase diffuses (Law 2 along the cycle)
